about: The Leyline Discord at launch (docs/DISCORD-PLAN.md, 3 Nov): the 30 Oct server kept and tidied, 14 channels (world-chat added 4 Nov) in START, PLAY, CREATE, FEEDBACK and STAFF. Names are "<emoji>︱<name>", the same as tools/discord-leyline/discord_leyline.py LAYOUT (a test checks they agree). The owner's Leyline Control runs that script (Discord card: Preview, then Do it); this file lets the website bot find the same channels (WU_DISCORD_TEMPLATE=/app/discord_template_launch.json). Set up the Discord only ever adds what is missing; a channel's "was" names count as it. The bigger plan, for later, is discord_template_v2.json.

channels.name: 👋︱welcome
channels.topic: Start here: what Leyline is, how to start in 3 steps, and the rules. Get the launcher: leylinelauncher.com/wrath/download

channels.name: 📣︱announcements
channels.topic: News from the Leyline team: releases, realms and events. Forum announcements show up here too.

channels.name: 📖︱guides-and-faq
channels.topic: Every guide and the common questions, in one place. All the guides: leylinelauncher.com/wrath/docs

channels.name: 💬︱general
channels.topic: Talk about anything Leyline: the realms, Your Den, game modes, what you are up to.

channels.name: 🌍︱world-chat
channels.topic: Wrath Unleashed's World chat, both ways: World lines from the game show up here, and what you write here shows in the game as [Discord]. Keep it friendly; muted names stay muted.

channels.name: 🛟︱help
channels.topic: Stuck? Ask here: installing, logging in, your Hero Key, game folders, playing, Your Den. The answers to common questions are in guides-and-faq.

channels.name: 🤝︱looking-for-group
channels.topic: Find people to play with: say the realm, your level and what you want to do.

channels.name: 🧩︱mods-and-workshop
channels.topic: Mods, addons and looks: share them, ask about them, get help. Made something? Type /submit with its link and it goes to the team's review queue.

channels.name: 🏰︱host-a-realm
channels.topic: Host your own realm from the launcher's Host page: help, setups, and telling people about your realm. The guide: leylinelauncher.com/wrath/docs/hosting

channels.name: 📸︱showcase
channels.topic: Screenshots and clips: your Den, your character, your realm.

channels.name: 🐞︱bug-reports
channels.topic: Found a bug? Say what you did, what you expected, what happened, and where. Every message here goes on the team's bug list.

channels.name: 💡︱ideas
channels.topic: Ideas for Leyline, one per message. React to the ones you want, and talk them over in a thread.

channels.name: 🔒︱mod-log
channels.topic: Staff only: moderation notes, reports and alerts.
